tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Private homes in Vancouver, Burnaby and West Vancouver, BC that are free for the dates, with the exact total (cleaning and 5% GST included, no service fee) and a link to each home's booking page.

tools.name: book_stay
tools.description: Holds the home for about 30 minutes and returns a secure Stripe payment link. The booking is confirmed only when the guest pays on that page. Needs the guest's full name and email.
